notes: Same series as animation2 (same character designs: red-marked boy, blond boy with pink streaks, masked pink-haired girl, old cyborg with round red goggles, smoking man with cracked face plate). UNCERTAIN: card 5 (greyscale man with round glasses, red eyes, stitched face) labelled old_cyborg as his flashback self; it could be a separate character. Cards 3 and 6 merged (cap on/off; times never overlap) but could be two siblings. Cards 8 and 16 merged. Card 13 (dim, light-haired, in the 11:00-11:38 scene with cards 8 and 9) labelled blond_boy, could be another girl. Card 17 and C4T0/C4T1 (grey-lavender hair, black mask, dark lighting) taken as pink_haired_girl.
